{{Top|leg}}
'''Animal telepathy''' allowed a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to read the thoughts of an animal and other creatures. The more intelligent the animal, the more complex the thoughts. This was a [[Force power/Legends|power]] that an individual could acquire by wearing the [[Carnelian crystal]], a type of [[Tasar crystal]].
